title: Prestador(a) de Serviços em Orçamento de Obras na Construção Civil - (PJ)
description:
Conheça o Grupo Projeta

O Grupo Projeta é formado por empresas de engenharia consultiva, que oferece soluções completas e integradas nas áreas de engenharia civil, meio ambiente, saneamento, recursos hídricos, gerenciamento de obras e investigações geológico-geotécnicas.

Também atua no desenvolvimento de importantes instrumentos de planejamento urbano, como Plano Diretor, Plano Municipal de Saneamento Básico, Plano de Mobilidade Urbana e Regularização Fundiária Urbana (REURB).

Com mais de 17 anos de experiência e um time com mais de 900 colaboradores, o Grupo Projeta se destaca pela busca contínua por soluções técnicas eficientes, assertivas e alinhadas à melhor experiência do cliente.

Com sede em Minas Gerais e presença em centenas de municípios em todo o país, atende tanto órgãos públicos quanto empresas privadas. Seu foco é desenvolver soluções que otimizem os resultados dos clientes, utilizando as técnicas mais modernas da engenharia.

Todos os serviços são realizados por uma equipe multidisciplinar especializada — formada por engenheiros, arquitetos, geólogos, geotécnicos e técnicos — que atuam de forma personalizada, com precisão, dentro das normas técnicas vigentes, garantindo qualidade e pontualidade em cada projeto.

Acreditamos na força da diversidade para transformar realidades e construir um futuro mais justo e inovador. Por isso, todas as nossas vagas são elegíveis para pessoas com deficiência (PcD) e a diferentes identidades e trajetórias.

description:

title: Sales Manager
description:
About WIN SOURCE

WIN SOURCE – Where Supply Begins

Founded in 1999, WIN SOURCE helps manufacturers secure critical electronic components and build more resilient supply chains in an increasingly complex global market,supported by a global team of 450+ employees.

Through NEXUSTM, our intelligent supply chain platform, and our worldwide network of sourcing, inventory and logistics capabilities, we help customers make smarter sourcing decisions, strengthen supply continuity and respond confidently to evolving market challenges.

Today, WIN SOURCE serves customers worldwide through strategically located operations across Asia, Europe and North America, certified facilities and a strong commitment to quality, reliability and operational excellence.

About the Role

The International Sales Manager role at WIN SOURCE focuses on building strategic partnerships with global OEMs, EMS providers and technology companies while helping customers solve complex electronic component supply challenges. Working with customers across AI infrastructure, automotive, industrial, medical and advanced electronics sectors, this role helps customers maintain production continuity and support critical programs where reliable component supply is essential.

This position plays an important role in supporting customers with component sourcing, shortage management, EOL risk mitigation, BOM optimization and supply continuity solutions through collaboration with WIN SOURCE's global sourcing, procurement and quality teams, and build more resilient supply chains that support innovation across industries.

Key Responsibilities

title: Cloud Migration Architect
description:
Cloud Migration Architect – AWS

Location: Remote

Rate: DOE

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced Cloud Migration Architect – AWS to design and lead the migration of applications and infrastructure into AWS cloud environments. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in AWS networking, cloud architecture, connectivity, security, and migration strategies.

The candidate will be responsible for architecting AWS accounts and migration solutions, ensuring secure, scalable, highly available, and well-connected cloud environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and architect AWS environments to support application and infrastructure migrations.
  • Design and implement AWS VPCs, subnets, route tables, Transit Gateway, and network connectivity.
  • Develop secure and scalable cloud network architectures based on business and application requirements.
  • Configure and optimize Security Groups, Network ACLs, routing, load balancing, and DNS.
  • Design connectivity between AWS and on-premises environments using VPN, Direct Connect, and other hybrid connectivity solutions.
  • Develop migration strategies, including rehost, replatform, refactor, and modernization approaches.
  • Analyze existing application and network environments and identify migration dependencies.
  • Design highly available and resilient AWS architectures across multiple Availability Zones and Regions where required.
  • Collaborate with application, infrastructure, security, and network engineering teams throughout migration projects.
  • Troubleshoot complex networking and connectivity issues during migration and post-migration activities.
  • Establish cloud architecture standards, documentation, and best practices.
  • Support security, compliance, performance, and cost optimization initiatives.

Required Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS cloud architecture and migration.
  • Extensive knowledge of AWS VPC, Transit Gateway, Route Tables, Security Groups, and NACLs.
  • Experience with AWS Load Balancers, Route 53/DNS, VPN, and Direct Connect.
  • Strong understanding of TCP/IP, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, and network security.
  • Experience designing hybrid cloud and on-premises connectivity.
  • Understanding of AWS security and identity services.
  • Experience with infrastructure architecture and cloud migration methodologies.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • AWS Solutions Architect certification or equivalent experience.
  • Experience with Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code technologies.
  • Experience with enterprise-scale AWS migration projects.
  • Knowledge of cloud security and compliance frameworks.
  • Experience working with large enterprise environments.

Mars Program is Keeta's flagship leadership accelerator — a strategic investment in the next generation of business leaders for Brazil. This is not a traditional hire. We are looking for high-potential talents who want to build a long-term career in Brazil, understand the food delivery business end-to-end, and grow into future leaders of this organization.

You will be assigned to one of the four core pillars of our business — Merchant, Consumer, Delivery, and Business Analytics — gaining a comprehensive, hands-on understanding of what it takes to build and scale a world-class food delivery platform.

What You'll Do

Your responsibilities will evolve across business areas, and may include:

  • Drive merchant acquisition, activation, and retention strategies to grow Keeta's supply-side ecosystem in Brazil.
  • Design and execute consumer growth and retention initiatives, tailoring strategies to local user behavior and market dynamics.
  • Optimize delivery operations — improving efficiency, rider experience, and fulfillment quality in the Brazilian market.
  • Conduct business analysis to translate data into strategic insights, supporting key decisions across functions.
  • Lead or contribute to cross-functional projects, collaborating with local and global teams to solve real business challenges.

What We're Looking For

  • Education: Full-time international MBA required. We seek candidates who have completed or are completing a full-time MBA program, bringing a global perspective and the academic foundation to lead in a complex, fast-growing market.
  • Background: Experience in consulting, finance, tech, fast-moving consumer goods, or management trainee programs is a strong fit. Candidates from outside the industry with demonstrated high potential are equally welcome.
  • Language: Fluent in Portuguese and English.
  • Mindset: Humble, hands-on, curious, resilient — excited by the ambiguity of building something from scratch, not just managing what's already there.

Why Join Mars Program

  • High Starting Point — a dual recognition of your past achievements and future potential. This is our commitment to attracting top talent.
  • End-to-End Business Exposure — specialize in one of our four core pillars. Build the holistic view and foundational logic of the food delivery business that most professionals spend a decade trying to piece together.
  • Executive Mentorship & Visibility — Enter a high-visibility talent pool with direct access to senior leadership, intensive coaching, and exposure to real strategic decisions.
  • World-Class Methodology — Benefit from Meituan's 15 years of deep industry know-how and scientific operating frameworks, now being applied to crack one of the world's most exciting new markets.

Work Location: São Paulo, Brazil.

Onboarding Target: September 2026

Keeta Brazil is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities (PwD). If you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know - we are here to support you.

Como líder mundial na fabricação de fertilizantes de eficiência aprimorada, oferecemos aos agricultores e à indústria soluções avançadas para uma agricultura de alto desempenho, incluindo produtos especiais de alta qualidade para diferentes necessidades. Nosso trabalho contribui para aumentar a produtividade, a rentabilidade e a qualidade de vida das pessoas.

No Brasil, nossa trajetória é marcada por crescimento sustentável, compromisso com a inovação e respeito às comunidades onde atuamos. Com unidades em diversas regiões do país, temos orgulho de impulsionar o desenvolvimento da agricultura brasileira, promovendo práticas mais eficientes e sustentáveis.

Nossa missão:

Gerar impacto positivo no mundo dos alimentos, agricultura e produtos industriais, avançando para um futuro sustentável para toda a humanidade.

Como fazemos isso:

Unimos nossos recursos naturais, a dedicação de uma equipe talentosa e nossa capacidade tecnológica para ampliar a produção de alimentos, garantir sua qualidade, viabilizar uma agricultura e uma produção industrial sustentáveis e proteger o meio ambiente.

Nossos princípios:

  • Inovação: Criada por pessoas apaixonadas, apoiada por infraestrutura de P&D e parcerias estratégicas, formando um ecossistema único.
  • Cuidado: Fazer o que é certo para nossos colaboradores, parceiros de negócios, acionistas, comunidades e meio ambiente.
  • Liderança: Atuar como referência em inovação, gestão de custos e sustentabilidade, com mentalidade orientada a resultados e espírito vencedor.

Requisitos:

  • Conhecimento em nutrição de plantas e fertilidade de solo (desejável);
  • Familiaridade com a região de atuação, proporcionando um atendimento eficaz e personalizado aos clientes.

Na ICL, acreditamos que a diversidade é o motor da inovação. Por isso, todas as nossas vagas são elegíveis para as pessoas independentemente de raça, gênero, deficiência, orientação sexual ou qualquer outra característica. Embora esta posição não seja afirmativa/exclusiva, reforçamos que todas as pessoas são bem-vindas a se candidatar. title: Gerente de Projetos
description:
Resumo do cargo:

Se você é um(a) profissional de Gerenciamento de Projetos em busca de uma oportunidade para desenvolver sua carreira, esta posição oferece a oportunidade de planejar, organizar e controlar recursos e processos para atingir os objetivos de projetos e programas dentro das restrições de escopo, prazo, qualidade e orçamento. O(a) Gerente de Projetos supervisiona os diversos projetos de engenharia implementados pela empresa para garantir que estejam alinhados à missão da organização e aos objetivos estratégicos dos programas.

A equipe de liderança da empresa normalmente define a direção estratégica e os resultados que deseja alcançar. Com base nisso, o(a) Gerente Sênior de Projetos monitora o progresso de vários projetos sob sua responsabilidade para garantir que sigam essa direção e superem as metas estabelecidas.

Nesse cargo, suas responsabilidades serão:

1. Liderança Técnica

Responsável pela orientação técnica geral dos projetos, incluindo definições de engenharia, decisões de desenvolvimento e integração entre diferentes disciplinas técnicas.

2. Controle de Cronograma e Custos

Desenvolver planos de trabalho, gerenciar orçamentos de projetos, acompanhar a alocação de recursos e realizar análises de custos para garantir a execução eficiente das atividades.

3. Conformidade com Qualidade e Segurança

Assegurar o cumprimento de normas do setor, requisitos de segurança (como diretrizes HSE ou ISO) e especificações técnicas de projeto.

4. Comunicação com Stakeholders

Atuar como principal ponto de contato técnico entre clientes, fornecedores externos e liderança executiva.

5. Mitigação de Riscos

Identificar possíveis obstáculos ao longo do ciclo de vida dos projetos de engenharia e implementar ações corretivas para minimizar impactos e garantir o sucesso das entregas.

Quem você é:

Você trabalha de forma colaborativa, contribuindo para um ambiente respeitoso e inclusivo, onde o aprendizado e a troca de conhecimento são valorizados. Demonstra atenção aos detalhes, disciplina e comprometimento com a qualidade e a integridade dos dados técnicos. Atua com responsabilidade e ética, seguindo procedimentos e normas, ao mesmo tempo em que busca aprender continuamente e melhorar a forma como o trabalho é realizado.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Graduação em Comércio Internacional e/ou Engenharia (Industrial, Química ou áreas correlatas).
  • Entre 10 e 12 anos de experiência em gestão de projetos para candidatos externos.
  • Entre 5 e 7 anos de experiência para candidatos internos.
  • Certificação PMP® (Project Management Professional) ou outra certificação reconhecida pelo PMI (Project Management Institute) será considerada um diferencial.
  • Inglês avançado.

Nossa Cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass); seguro de vida; cooperativa de crédito; previdência privada; reconhecimento e muito mais. Nossa cultura de apoio às nossas pessoas oferece grupos de recursos e programa de assistência aos colaboradores, além de licença parental estendida (materna e paterna) por ser Empresa Cidadã.

title: Engenheiro SR
description:

Quais as responsabilidades?

Governança do Programa Berlim;

Gestão do Plano Diretor de Manutenção Automotiva;

Gestão da estratégia de confiabilidade dos ativos;

Desenvolvimento de iniciativas de alavancagem dos resultados e gestão através do MasterPlan do Programa Berlim;

Elaborar padrões e suportar as unidades referente aos processos de Gestão de Ativos;

Conduzir definição de metas e estratégias de manutenção;

Realizar treinamento nas unidades;

Realizar auditorias de conformidade;

Quais os requisitos?

Ensino superior completo em Engenharia Mecânica (preferencial) ou demais engenharias correlatas;

Desejável pós-graduação em Engenharia de Confiabilidade ou Engenharia de Manutenção;

Experiência em Engenharia de Confiabilidade, Engenharia de Manutenção ou Gestão de Ativos;

Vivência em projetos de confiabilidade voltados para a manutenção automotiva agrícola;

Experiência em ambiente corporativo com atuação em múltiplas unidades industriais;

Conhecimento em Gestão de Ativos (ISO 55000), RCM, FMEA, RCA, Análise de Weibull, RAM, Planejamento e Controle da Manutenção (PCM) e indicadores de desempenho;

Conhecimento em SAP PM, Excel Avançado e Power BI;

Habilidade para comunicação, influência e relacionamento com diferentes níveis da organização;

Perfil analítico, com capacidade para solucionar problemas e tomar decisões de forma ágil e assertiva;

Orientação para resultados, foco em melhoria contínua e gestão por indicadores;

Qual localidade?

São José do Rio Preto/SP.

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

  • A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.

If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!

In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:

  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Remote Real Estate Lawyer - Brazil
description:
About Moritz

Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.

We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.

We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.

Moritz has raised a $9M seed round from Y Combinator, 20VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.

The Role

  • Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's real estate work in Brazil: commercial leases, sale and purchase agreements, real estate aspects of corporate transactions, and development and construction agreements.
  • Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of leases and property transaction documents for clients ranging from startups taking their first office to enterprises managing property portfolios.
  • Run title review and property due diligence, including for real estate elements of M&A and financing transactions.
  • Advise on real estate financing and security, planning and zoning questions, and landlord-tenant matters.
  • If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years practising commercial real estate law in private practice or in-house.
  • Leasing depth. Office, retail, industrial, and flexible-space leases — rent review, service charges, repair obligations, break options, and assignments.
  • Transactional experience. Sale and purchase agreements, title review and due diligence, conditions, and completion mechanics.
  • Financing familiarity. Mortgages, security packages, and the real estate workstreams of corporate deals.
  • Practical judgment. You separate the points that protect the client from the points that stall the deal.
  • Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

  • Bring speed and clarity to real estate transactions traditionally slowed by process.
  • Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice.
  • Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity.
  • Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: International Channel Account Manager - Healthcare & Medical Technology
description:
Brazil, South America | Full-Time | Permanent | International Channel Sales & Distribution

Placed by Hotsourced – connecting top global talent with world-class international companies.

About the Role

We are looking for a commercially driven and experienced International Account Manager to take ownership of an international territory and portfolio of distributor partners.

You will work closely with distributors to develop territory plans, deliver sales targets, expand market penetration, launch products, identify new opportunities, and strengthen the organisation's presence across international markets.

This is a consultative, relationship-led sales role requiring someone who can operate confidently across different cultures, markets, and levels of seniority.

You will be expected to understand market dynamics, identify commercial opportunities, analyse competitor activity, forecast sales accurately, and translate strategy into measurable revenue growth. The role involves approximately 40% international travel, including the potential for 2–3 weeks away from home at a time, depending on business requirements.

If you are an experienced international sales professional who enjoys developing markets, working through distribution partners, and delivering measurable commercial results, this is an opportunity to take ownership of a significant international territory within a growing global healthcare business.

Responsibilities – What you'll be doing

  • Managing a portfolio of international distributor and channel partners across Brazil and assigned South American markets.
  • Developing and executing distributor and country-level business plans to achieve agreed sales targets.
  • Taking ownership of assigned territories and identifying opportunities for revenue growth and increased market penetration.
  • Delivering monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, and annual sales targets.
  • Building strong, commercially focused relationships with distributors, healthcare customers, clinicians, educators, and key stakeholders.
  • Supporting distributors to increase product penetration, customer reach, and market share.
  • Developing smaller accounts and resellers into stronger, higher-value distribution partners.
  • Identifying, recruiting, and onboarding new distributors across assigned territories.
  • Supporting new product launches and market-entry strategies.
  • Developing annual territory plans based on market trends, healthcare developments, customer needs, and commercial opportunities.
  • Monitoring competitor activity, pricing, market positioning, and emerging trends.
  • Providing accurate and timely sales forecasts to support business planning.
  • Monitoring distributor performance against agreed KPIs, budgets, and revenue targets.
  • Identifying commercial risks and opportunities and taking appropriate corrective action.
  • Providing product training and commercial guidance to distributor sales teams.
  • Sharing sales best practice and international market knowledge with distribution partners.
  • Supporting distributors with sales collateral, product positioning, marketing campaigns, and product launches.
  • Representing the organization at international conferences, exhibitions, and industry events.
  • Ensuring products are accurately positioned and represented across distributor websites and sales channels.
  • Maintaining accurate commercial information, sales data, forecasts, and account records using CRM and relevant business systems.

Requirements – What we're looking for

Essential

  • Minimum 5 years' experience in international channel sales, distributor management, or partner sales.
  • Proven experience independently managing an international region or territory.
  • Demonstrable track record of achieving sales targets and delivering measurable revenue growth.
  • Strong experience working with distributors, channel partners, or reseller networks.
  • Experience developing new markets and launching products within international territories.
  • Strong commercial planning, sales forecasting, and territory management skills.
  • Comfortable working with sales budgets, targets, KPIs, and commercial data.
  • Strong competitor analysis and market intelligence capability.
  • Excellent relationship-building and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to present confidently to audiences ranging from C-suite executives to sales teams and end users.
  • Excellent written and spoken Portuguese, Spanish, English,
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of a territory.
  • Willingness and ability to undertake significant international travel, approximately 40% of working time.
  • Comfortable being away from home for extended international trips, potentially 2–3 weeks at a time.

Desirable

Experience within one or more of the following sectors:

  • Medical Technology / MedTech
  • Medical Devices
  • Healthcare Technology
  • Medical Equipment
  • Medical Simulation
  • Clinical Skills Training
  • Life Sciences
  • Diagnostics
  • Laboratory Equipment
  • Healthcare Education Technology
  • Working within a start-up, scale-up, or entrepreneurial environment.
  • Salesforce or another CRM system.
  • Developing distributor sales teams through product and commercial training.
  • Transitioning reseller relationships into formal distributor partnerships.
  • Working across emerging and established international markets.

Language Requirements (non negotiable)

  • 1st price Fluent Portuguese
  • Fluent business level Spanish is essential
  • Fluent business-level English is essential.

Education & Qualifications

  • Degree-level qualification preferred.
  • A qualification or professional background in Nursing, Medicine, Healthcare, Life Sciences, or a related field would be advantageous.
  • Equivalent commercial experience will also be considered.

The Profile We're Looking For

  • Mature, experienced, and commercially confident.
  • Comfortable owning and managing an international region.
  • An experienced international traveller with strong exposure to different markets and cultures.
  • Highly capable of building and maintaining distributor relationships.
  • Commercially analytical and comfortable working with numbers, targets, budgets, and forecasts.
  • A fast learner who can quickly understand new products, markets, customers, and competitive environments.
  • Confident working autonomously while knowing when to escalate issues.
  • Professional and articulate, with strong presentation and communication skills.
  • Highly organized with excellent time-management skills.
  • Resilient and adaptable in a fast-moving international environment.

Work Schedule

  • This is a full-time, permanent position based in Brazil.
  • The role requires flexibility to accommodate different international markets, customers, distributors, and time zones.
  • International travel will form a significant part of the position, at approximately 40% of working time.
  • Travel may include extended international trips of 2–3 weeks at a time, as well as conferences, exhibitions, distributor meetings, product launches, and customer visits.

Pay & Benefits – What we offer

  • Very Competitive salary package.
  • Full-time, permanent opportunity based in Brazil.
  • Opportunity to work with a growing international healthcare and medical technology business.
  • Significant ownership of an international territory and distributor portfolio.
  • Exposure to global healthcare markets, clinicians, educators, and international commercial partners.
  • International travel and participation in industry conferences and events.
  • Opportunity to contribute directly to international market expansion and revenue growth.
  • Career development within a growing global commercial team.
  • Collaborative and commercially focused international working environment.

What Success Looks Like

  • International sales targets are consistently achieved.
  • Distributor revenue and performance continue to grow.
  • New distributors are successfully identified, onboarded, and developed.
  • Existing distributor relationships become stronger and more commercially productive.
  • New markets and product opportunities are identified and developed.
  • Sales forecasts are accurate, timely, and commercially meaningful.
  • Territory plans translate into measurable revenue and market growth.
  • Competitor and market intelligence is actively used to identify opportunities and risks.
  • Distributor sales teams are well trained and equipped to represent the product portfolio.
  • CRM, pipeline, forecasting, and account information remain accurate and up to date.

Reality Check

  • This is not a traditional desk-based Account Manager role.
  • You will be responsible for managing an international territory, working through distributors, developing markets, delivering sales targets, and representing the business across different countries and cultures.
  • The role requires someone who is comfortable with commercial accountability, frequent international travel, independent decision-making, and working across multiple markets simultaneously.
  • There will be periods where you may be away from home for several weeks, and flexibility around international travel, customer requirements, conferences, and business events is essential.
  • You will need to be commercially curious, highly organized, culturally adaptable, and confident enough to build relationships with stakeholders at every level.
  • If you have a proven track record in international channel sales, distributor management, territory growth, and new market development, and you're ready to take ownership of a global commercial portfolio, this could be an excellent opportunity to take your international sales career to the next level.

Hit Apply and take the next step in your international sales career.

We are ARVORE, a startup in the virtual reality content creation scene. Our process emphasizes teamwork, agility, and multidisciplinarity. We are looking for a passionate and self-motivated person with a positive attitude and a genuine team player, who likes to share knowledge and is open to learning from others. We embrace problem solvers, those who aren't afraid to experiment and fail, and are ready to create something new.

ARVORE is looking to hire a technically adept, creative individual to complement our team. You will have the opportunity to work on innovative immersive and narrative-driven XR experiences, iterating and prototyping with a high level of creative freedom and with the opportunity to guide the direction of some of these endeavors.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Creative Directors are responsible for defining and nurturing the product’s vision, understanding the company’s strategic goals, and keeping everyone’s efforts focused towards the same direction.

Always aligned with the Production Manager and the Head of Studio, Creative Directors are responsible for defining and constantly reviewing the scope to keep projects on budget and on time.

This work also requires establishing the foundations of the experiences in all three pillars (artistic, systems, and narrative). The Creative Directors will articulate their vision, fostering an environment of collective creativity that inspires the team to come up with the best ideas, choosing the ones that fit into a coherent whole.

MAIN CROSS-FUNCTIONAL ACTIVITIES:

  1. Define a clear and reasonable creative vision for the product.
  2. Work closely with the Core Team members to develop their specific parts of the vision, tying together all artistic and technical elements.
  3. Constantly review the priorities and scope of each product delivery and/or milestone together with the Product Manager, considering the Value Proposition and goals of the product, but at the same time championing the product’s unique vision.
  4. Review production timelines, budget, and team performance with the Product Manager.
  5. Nurture and communicate the overall creative direction on an ongoing basis, inspiring the team through leadership.
  6. Be aware of internal and external QA results to direct creative decisions, ensuring the product meets main stakeholders' needs.
  7. Guarantee the consistency and quality of the product, ensuring creative cohesion between the user experience and company strategy.
  8. Serve as the spokesperson for the product’s vision within the team, for the press, and corporate management.

MUST HAVE:

  • Experience in a creative leadership position on at least one high-quality professional entertainment product/property shipped or delivered in industries such as XR, Games, Movies, Television, Advertisement, or Comics.
  • Positive leadership qualities.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to listen and communicate effectively (spoken and written).
  • Fluency in English.
  • Understanding and sensitivity to capturing the spirit of the moment (Zeitgeist).
  • Deep understanding of current trends in XR, gaming, and entertainment industries, influencing user expectations and behaviors.
  • Huge curiosity and openness to research and expand knowledge in virtual reality games, narratives, immersive art, etc.

NICE TO HAVE:

  • Familiarity with Google G Suite, Monday, Slack, and Github.
  • Fluency in Portuguese.
  • Previous experience with VR and AR content is desirable.
  • A passion for Games, Movies, TV, Art, Animation, Electronics, RPGs, Literature, Theater, Popular Culture, and narrative experiences.
  • Knowledge of other project management techniques.
  • Experience in a technology or content development environment.

Sobre a UEX

Somos Nerds e Empreendedores!

A UEX é um estúdio de tecnologia, que opera no modelo de Startup Studio. Uma empresa de tecnologia, especialista em desenvolvimento, lançamento e operação de produtos e plataformas digitais.

COMO VOCÊ VAI CRIAR DRAGÕES?

Como Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) aqui na UEX você será responsável por provisionar e manter recursos em cloud, apoiar a criação/atualização de ambientes de projeto, implementar soluções de observabilidade e administrar credenciais e plataformas corporativas.

Está é uma posição Presencial, perfeita para quem Curitiba e região. Regime PJ ou Cooperado, além disso o processo seletivo é conduzido remotamente. Caso seja necessário um encontro presencial, nós avisaremos com antecedência para combinar a melhor data.

Requisitos

Você será responsável por:

  • Provisionar e manter recursos em cloud (VMs, bancos de dados, CDNs, storage, balanceadores e redes).
  • Garantir governança de tags, manutenção preventiva/corretiva e segurança básica do ambiente (hardening, MFA/IAM, backups, patches, criptografia, firewall/WAF).
  • Realizar gestão de custos (FinOps básico), incluindo budgets, rightsizing, reserved/savings plans e otimização de uso.
  • Automatizar provisionamento e rotinas de operação com IaC (Terraform/Ansible) e runbooks documentados.
  • Dar suporte a projetos, provisionando infraestrutura em diferentes estágios (dev/test/homolog/produção) e conduzindo upgrades/migrações com mínima indisponibilidade.
  • Colaborar com os times de desenvolvimento para viabilizar deploys, pipelines e boas práticas de confiabilidade.
  • Implementar e manter observabilidade, configurando Zabbix (dashboards, itens, gatilhos, templates) e New Relic (agentes, APM, alert policies e notificações), além de definir SLOs/SLIs e alertas acionáveis.
  • Administrar plataformas corporativas como Microsoft 365 (credenciais, licenças, grupos e políticas básicas de segurança), Azure DevOps (usuários, repositórios, pipelines e permissões), redes (UniFi/OpenVPN, VLANs, troubleshooting) e Proxmox (containers LXC, rede, quotas, backup/restore e monitoramento).

Para Ter Sucesso Nessa Posição, Você Precisa Ter

  • Experiência sólida com cloud computing (Azure, AWS ou GCP).
  • Conhecimentos em automação/IaC (Terraform, Ansible ou similares).
  • Vivência com observabilidade (Zabbix, New Relic ou equivalentes).
  • Noções de FinOps e otimização de custos em cloud.
  • Familiaridade com administração de Microsoft 365, Azure DevOps, redes e Proxmox.
  • Visão crítica para propor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance.
  • Capacidade de traduzir problemas complexos em soluções práticas e sustentáveis.
  • Autonomia e organização para lidar com múltiplos ambientes.
  • Espírito colaborativo para trabalhar próximo aos times de desenvolvimento e produto.

Se você é apaixonado por desafios, criatividade e deseja fazer parte de um ambiente onde sua contribuição é valorizada e incentivada, venha se juntar a nós!

PROCESSO SELETIVO

No processo seletivo da UEX, você passará por uma série de etapas que visam identificar e valorizar os melhores talentos para integrar nossa equipe.

title: Senior Legal Counsel (Unconventional Gas)- Relocate to Saudi Arabia
description:
Senior Legal Counsel (Unconventional Gas) – Relocate to Saudi Arabia

Candidate must relocate to Saudi Arabia.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer. With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Overview

We are seeking a Senior Legal Counsel to join the Gas Corporate & Commercial Legal Practice in the Upstream Law Department within the Aramco Law Organization.

The Gas Corp & Commercial Legal Practice provides legal support to the company’s upstream unconventional gas business, including drilling, production, processing and day-to-day operations as well as related joint ventures and subsidiaries.

As Senior Counsel, your primary role is to provide comprehensive corporate and commercial legal services, working closely with internal stakeholders and coordinating with specialist legal teams in areas such as tax, intellectual property (IP), mergers and acquisitions (M&A), and dispute resolution. The role will require collaboration with external legal counsel as needed.

Key Responsibilities

  • Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of contracts and legal agreements.
  • Provide strategic legal advice to internal clients, identifying and mitigating potential legal risks while supporting business objectives.
  • Lead or support multidisciplinary legal and commercial projects, ensuring timely and effective delivery.
  • Advise on claims management and dispute resolution processes.
  • Serve as Board Secretary for designated joint ventures and subsidiaries.
  • Manage relationships with external legal counsel, including oversight of legal budgets and service quality.

Required Qualifications

  • A Bachelor of Law degree as minimum. Master or Juris degree preferred.
  • Current admission to general practice before the highest court of the state or country of which you are a citizen or resident.
  • A minimum of 10 years experience gained in a sophisticated law firm or corporation. Preferably within a major international or national energy company or oilfield services organization.
  • Demonstrated in-depth understanding of the upstream oil and gas industry, particularly unconventional gas operations.
  • Proven ability to negotiate complex commercial agreements and deliver clear, practical legal advice to business clients.
  • Strong leadership and mentorship experience, with the ability to guide junior legal professionals.

Software Architect — We're urgently hiring a Software Architect to join our growing remote team at LawnStarter. See what we’re building.

Why This Role Rocks

  • Own What You Build - Lead projects end-to-end with full autonomy and real impact

Our Tech Stack

  • Languages & Frameworks: PHP (Laravel), JavaScript (React, React Native, Vue)
  • Cloud Services: AWS (Lambda, ECS, EKS, Aurora, Redshift)
  • Approach: We\'re not fixated on specific languages. If you have strong engineering fundamentals and experience with any mainstream object-oriented language, you can quickly learn and adapt to our tech stack

What You'll Do

As a Software Architect , you\'ll work closely with the engineering team to:

  • Collaborate on designing and implementing system architecture, technical strategy, and engineering standards.
  • Lead technical initiatives across teams, ensuring alignment with architectural direction and goals.
  • Build and maintain platform-level components, services, and libraries that enhance engineering efficiency and system maintainability.
  • Mentor engineers through code reviews, pair programming, and hands-on guidance.
  • Contribute directly to both server-side and client-side development across the entire stack.
  • Write and review technical design documents, system diagrams, and reference implementations.
  • Evaluate and implement new tools, frameworks, and best practices to continuously improve our platform.
  • Enhance observability, performance, scalability, and security throughout our system.
  • Share knowledge and insights to foster team growth and improvement.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • Experienced: A software architect, principal engineer, lead full-stack engineer, or someone with relevant experience in similar roles.
  • Highly skilled in both server-side and client-side software development.
  • Technically Proficient: Familiar with cloud development (AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure).
  • Experienced with Test Driven Development (TDD), RESTful APIs, React, MVC frameworks, and security concerns (e.g., XSS attacks).
  • Fundamentally Strong in Computer Science Concepts: You can explain concepts like Big O notation, pointers, composition vs. inheritance, and data structures such as arrays, sets, and linked lists.
  • Database-Savvy: Proficient in SQL and NoSQL databases, and understand operations like CRUD, indexes, and joins.
  • Cloud Infrastructure Expert: Comfortable working with cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS Lambda, ECS, EKS, Aurora) and utilizing Infrastructure as Code (IAC).
  • Customer-Centric: Passionate about clean code and building customer-driven solutions with a focus on quality and reliability.

All team members at LawnStater are expected to embody our core values which are: Be data-driven, Get shit done, People are critical, Challenge the status quo, Be scrappy, and Be the Customer.

A Minerva Foods é líder em exportação de carne bovina na América do Sul e atua também no segmento de industrializados, comercializando seus produtos para mais de 100 países. Além do Brasil, a Minerva Foods está presente no Paraguai, na Argentina, no Uruguai, na Colômbia, e possui plantas especializadas em ovinos na Austrália.

Com nossas 46 unidades industriais, oferecemos produtos saudáveis e nutritivos, que são comercializados para clientes do mundo todo por meio de nossos 23 centros de distribuição e 17 escritórios internacionais.

Na Minerva Foods, a cultura é construída com base em valores como orientação para resultados, comprometimento, inovação, sustentabilidade e reconhecimento . A empresa promove um ambiente inclusivo, seguro e saudável, com programas como o Estar Bem, que oferece apoio psicológico, telemedicina, nutrição e atividades físicas para colaboradores e suas famílias.

Como Especialista de Infraestrutura na Minerva Foods, você será responsável pela operação e manutenção de ambientes críticos de tecnologia, garantindo a estabilidade, disponibilidade e performance dos serviços corporativos. Atuará diretamente na sustentação de servidores, redes, serviços em nuvem e suporte de nível avançado, colaborando com equipes internas e fornecedores para assegurar a continuidade dos negócios. Além disso, será parte ativa na identificação de oportunidades de melhoria contínua, contribuindo para a evolução dos processos, aumento da eficiência operacional e redução de riscos técnicos.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

O Especialista de Infraestrutura será um pilar técnico na equipe, responsável por garantir que nossos sistemas e redes operem com máxima eficiência, segurança e escalabilidade.

Principais atividades:

  • Gerenciamento de Infraestrutura: Administrar, sustentar e otimizar a infraestrutura de servidores (físicos e virtuais), storages e soluções de backup;
  • Administração de Redes: Gerenciar e proteger o ambiente de rede corporativa (LAN, WAN, WLAN, VPNs), incluindo a configuração e manutenção de firewalls e outros dispositivos de segurança;
  • Serviços de Diretório e Nuvem: Administrar o Active Directory, incluindo GPOs, DNS, DHCP, e gerenciar os serviços em nuvem, com foco no ecossistema Microsoft 365 (Azure AD, SharePoint, Teams);
  • Segurança da Informação: Implementar e gerenciar soluções de segurança, realizar análises de vulnerabilidade e garantir a correta aplicação das políticas de autenticação (ex: RADIUS/NPS);
  • Liderança de Projetos: Planejar, executar e documentar projetos de infraestrutura, como migrações de sistemas operacionais (ex: Windows 11), atualizações de hardware e implementação de novas tecnologias;
  • Melhoria Contínua: Analisar o ambiente atual, propor melhorias contínuas nos processos e tecnologias para aumentar a eficiência operacional, reduzir custos e mitigar riscos;
  • Suporte Especializado: Atuar como ponto de escalonamento para incidentes e problemas complexos, oferecendo soluções robustas e definitivas.

Experiências que buscamos:

  • Sólida experiência atuando como Analista de Infraestrutura Sênior ou Especialista;
  • Vivência comprovada em ambientes de virtualização;
  • Experiência prática com gerenciamento de redes corporativas e firewalls de borda;
  • Profundo conhecimento em administração de ambientes Microsoft, incluindo Windows Server e Active Directory;
  • Experiência com administração de plataformas em nuvem, preferencialmente AWS, Microsoft Azure e Microsoft 365;
  • Familiaridade com práticas de melhoria contínua.

Requisitos e qualificações:

Formação:

Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

Conhecimentos Técnicos Essenciais:

  • Virtualização: VMware vSphere e/ou Microsoft Hyper‑V;
  • Autenticação: RADIUS, NPS, LDAP, SAML;
  • Automação: Conhecimentos em scripting, especialmente PowerShell, para automação de tarefas no Active Directory e Azure.

Cursos e Certificações (Diferencial):

  • Certificações Microsoft (ex: Azure Administrator Associate, MCSA/MCSE);
  • Certificações de Redes (ex: Fortinet NSE 4, Cisco CCNA);
  • Certificação ITIL Foundation.

description:
iHunters is partnering with a leading global iGaming company, operating in 19 markets with over 2,700 employees worldwide, to hire a Tax Manager for their growing operation in Brazil.

This is a unique opportunity for professionals looking to work in a highly dynamic, international, and regulated environment, with the chance to directly influence the growth and structuring of the Brazilian operation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the main point of contact for all tax-related matters in Brazil, ensuring full compliance with local tax regulations, especially within the gaming and online betting sector.
  • Develop and implement tax strategies aligned with corporate guidelines and Brazilian legislation.
  • Monitor tax and regulatory changes, assess risks and opportunities, and implement required updates to processes and policies.
  • Manage and review the calculation of direct and indirect taxes, including preparation and submission of tax obligations.
  • Support tax audits, inspections, and interactions with regulatory bodies.
  • Collaborate closely with local and international teams, including Finance, Treasury, Legal, and Regulatory Affairs, providing tax advisory support to business stakeholders.

  • Solid experience in tax management, with deep knowledge of Brazilian direct and indirect taxes, as well as tax compliance processes.
  • Strong understanding of the regulatory environment, ideally with experience in digital businesses, technology, fintech, or gaming sectors.
  • Previous experience in multinational environments or large corporations, preferably with international reporting lines.
  • Fluent English (both written and spoken) mandatory.
  • Hands-on profile, strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and ownership mindset.
  • Ability to thrive in dynamic environments, with a sense of urgency and excellent interpersonal skills.

Work Model & Benefits

  • Hybrid work model (São Paulo).
  • Competitive salary + annual bonus.
  • Meal allowance.
  • Private health and dental insurance (extensible to dependents).
  • Life insurance.
  • Access to a global online learning platform (Udemy) and continuous development programs.
  • Collaborative, multicultural, and inclusive work environment.

title: Information Security Engineer
description:
4 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Array Technologies, Inc. is a global leader in solar energy solutions – and we have been for over 30 years! Our dramatic growth is creating incredible opportunities on our dynamic, innovative and

creative team. Are you self-motivated, highly-skilled and possess previous Cyber Security / Information Security experience?

Would you love to play a key role in advancing the clean energy revolution? Join the company that is leading the way!

What you’ll do:

The engineer will be a key member in maturing the IT and OT Security organization. They will be part of a global security team that provides support for all areas of Information Security. A successful candidate will have experience with and/or strong interest in becoming a subject matter expert in multiple Security disciplines. These include Zero Trust Architecture, Application and Cloud Security, IAM and/or Data Protection/DLP. Additionally, the engineer will be a point of escalation for investigating and remediating potential threats. The engineer will continuously be apprised of emerging technologies, threats, attacks, and countermeasures and recommend enhancements based on industry best practices. You will:

  • Design, document, test, maintain, and provide issue resolution recommendations for security solutions related to Zero Trust tools, secure software development, cloud, access, authentication/directory services, email, and/or endpoint security.
  • Work with various departments to design, implementation, and maintain IAM policy.
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of Zero Trust Architecture and SASE tools.
  • Partner with Dev teams to define, execute, and continuously improve our secure software development processes.
  • Partner with IT and Product teams to assess, document and develop Cloud Security best practices.
  • Participates in security incident response activities, conducts technical investigation of security-related incidents and conducts post-incident digital forensics to identify causes and recommend future mitigation strategies.
  • Identifies security vulnerabilities/issues, performs risk assessments, and evaluates remediation alternatives.
  • Contributes to the development and maintenance of information security architecture.
  • Collaborates with other IT teams such as infrastructure and application development in the protection of the company’s IT assets including network, servers, applications, and 3rd party service providers.
  • Contributes to the development of ongoing information security policies and procedures, and ensures such policies and procedures are put into practice in the day-to-day operations of the company’s technology environment.

The qualifications you must have:

  • Some Experience with IAM, SASE, SSDLC, SIEM/SOAR, EDR, EPP
  • Knowledge of Cybersecurity architectures and methodologies (OWASP, Github Advanced Security, Azure DevOps, Zero Trust, NIST, Defense in depth, Kill-Chain, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Secure Cloud Architecture, Vulnerability Management, and Incident Response
  • Familiar with Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Data Protection, and Disaster Recovery
  • Familiar with network/security (IDS/IPS, firewalls, DNS, DHCP)
  • Technical knowledge of Microsoft and Linux

Our preferred qualifications:

  • Cyber Security certifications.
  • 5-10 years of IT industry experience with 3-5 years of those in a role directly related to information security and IT compliance disciplines such as app security, cloud security, IAM, DLP, SASE, etc.
  • Strong subject matter expertise in one or more of technical disciplines such as IT infrastructure, applications development and/or information security.
  • Familiarity with information security disciplines such as privacy protection and data loss prevention.
  • Strong experience in managing cybersecurity incidents and event response.
  • Awareness of industry standards such as ISO, NIST as they relate to information security and protection of privacy.
  • Experience with NERC-CIP standard and polices a plus.
  • Experienced in executing privacy compliance initiatives in response to global privacy regulations such as GDPR and LGPD would be an asset.
  • Knowledge of national and international regulatory compliances and frameworks such as ISO, NIST, and SOX.

Who We Are

At BriteCore, we’re a dynamic, forward-thinking company on a mission to empower Property & Casualty (P&C) insurers to grow their business and achieve operational efficiencies with modern cloud-native technology.

Our software platform is mission-critical, enabling carrier customers to manage policies, billing, and claims with an all-in-one core insurance solution that delivers real-time analytics and digital portals for agents and policyholders. We believe in creating an inclusive and collaborative work environment where team members are encouraged to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and grow both personally and professionally. Our distributed team is united by a shared passion for transforming the insurance industry and delivering exceptional service.

Join us at BriteCore and be part of a company that’s shaping the future of insurance technology. You’ll have the opportunity to work with talented individuals and make an impact. Your contributions will make a difference. If you’re ready to create something different, let’s build the future of insurance software together.

Summary

Our team is growing, and we’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help shape the future of technology services for Property & Casualty (P&C) carriers. This is a customer facing role focused on implementing AI powered solutions and configuring our platform with Python, MySQL and automation tools. You’ll collaborate closely with customers to translate business needs into technical outcomes, ensuring our AI enhanced systems deliver performance, reliability and impact.

If you love solving complex problems, thrive in AI driven environments, and enjoy working closely with customers to deliver secure, scalable solutions, we’d like to chat with you.

This is a fully remote based role, however candidates must be located in Argentina or Brazil. This is a long-term Independent Contractor position.

Note: please submit your resume in English.

What You'll Do

  • Work directly with customers to understand business needs and translate them into AI enhanced technical solutions
  • Configure and extend our platform using Python, MySQL and AI APIs to deliver intelligent functionality

  • 5+ years of experience in Python web development
  • 3+ years of SaaS product development experience, including cloud based solutions
  • 3+ years of professional experience with relational databases (e.g., MySQL)
  • 3+ years of experience with Django or another Python framework
  • 2+ years of proven experience building and consuming APIs
  • Hands on experience using AI enhanced IDEs (e.g., Cursor, VS Code) to accelerate delivery, simplify workflows and focus on high value problem solving
  • Experience with agentic frameworks (e.g., AutoGen, LangGraph, CrewAI)
  • Professional experience working with Docker for containerization and AWS services such as EC2, API Gateway and Lambda
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Bonus points

  • 2+ years of experience working at a scaling startup
  • Experience working in a customer facing role

Life at BriteCore

We take pride in our dynamic, diverse team, unified by shared values of community, integrity, grit and impact. We love what we do and the people we do it with, which is why we welcome every individual, provide them with equal opportunity irrespective of their race, color, national origin, religion, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, veteran, disability or any other legally protected rights that one has.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Sobre a Zippi

A Zippi tem como missão ajudar a impulsionar os 22 milhões de micro e pequenos negócios (MPEs) no Brasil com soluções financeiras que realmente atendem às suas necessidades. Fomos pioneiros no uso do PIX como plataforma de crédito , permitindo que MPEs acessem capital de giro de forma instantânea. Com apenas um toque, nossos clientes conseguem pagar despesas do negócio e ainda contar com até 10 dias para pagar, garantindo um fluxo de caixa mais saudável para suas operações.

Desde o nosso lançamento, alcançamos a lucratividade e experimentamos um crescimento exponencial . Hoje, processamos mais de R$ 3,4 bilhões em pagamentos por ano e estamos escalando rapidamente para nos tornarmos a principal solução de crédito no mercado brasileiro de MPEs, que movimenta cerca de R$ 1,6 trilhão ao ano. Assim como os cartões de crédito transformaram o consumo, a Zippi está redefinindo como os pequenos negócios gerenciam seu fluxo de caixa.

Com o apoio de investidores de alto nível, como Y Combinator e Tiger Global, estamos formando um time de tecnologia de classe mundial para construir um futuro em que todo pequeno negócio no Brasil possa prosperar. Se você busca uma oportunidade de causar impacto real em uma causa que vale a pena , em uma das fintechs que mais cresce em mercados emergentes, enfrentando um desafio multibilionário - a Zippi é o lugar certo pra você.

Sobre o Time

Somos um time coeso e de alta performance sempre com foco em entregar valor para os nossos clientes . Aqui, as pessoas engenheiras possuem um papel estratégico, participando de projetos de alto impacto, focando na geração de valor do produto e na entrega de soluções sustentáveis.

Em parceria direta com produto, design, dados e demais áreas de negócio, garantindo que as pessoas engenheiras tenham contexto amplo para tomar decisões que geram valor real para o negócio da Zippi.

Sua Missão

Na Zippi, sua missão será atuar junto aos times de produto, design, dados e demais áreas de negócio para transformar insights de mercado e necessidades dos nossos usuários em soluções tecnológicas de ponta. Você deverá:

  • Entender as dores e os comportamentos dos MPEs que usam nosso produto, propondo hipóteses de melhoria com base em dados e feedback real.
  • Colaborar em equipes multifuncionais (produto, design, dados, negócios), traduzindo requisitos de negócio em soluções e fluxos de dados que garantam alta performance, escalabilidade e manutenibilidade.
  • Priorizar entregas de forma orientada a resultados , equilibrando velocidade e qualidade; medir o impacto das suas entregas por meio de métricas claras (retenção, conversão, satisfação).
  • Assumir a liderança técnica de projetos de alto impacto , propondo soluções criativas, resilientes e escaláveis no longo prazo.
  • Trabalhar de ponta a ponta: do desenho de protótipos à instrumentação em produção, passando por testes automatizados e ajustes rápidos próprios de um ambiente ágil.

O que buscamos

  • Mentalidade de Produto : você pensa além do “faça funcionar” e questiona “isso resolve o problema certo?”.
  • Foco em Resultados : orienta suas decisões por métricas de negócio e pelo sucesso do usuário, não apenas por linhas de código entregues.
  • Comunicação Clara : sabe alinhar visões técnicas e de produto, facilitando discussões e tomando decisões conjuntas com outras áreas.
  • Versatilidade em Tecnologia : tem experiência sólida em alguma stack moderna, e sem apego a ferramentas ou linguagens específicas.
  • Autonomia e Protagonismo : assume responsabilidades, conduz experimentos A/B, itera rápido e aprende com os resultados, sem depender de micro-gestão.
  • Curiosidade e Evolução Contínua : busca novas tecnologias, melhores práticas e tendências de mercado, elevando o patamar técnico e de produto do nosso ecossistema.

Por que vir para a Zippi?

  • Uma causa pela qual vale a pena lutar : nossa missão é ajudar micro e pequenas empresas a prosperar. Seu trabalho impactará diretamente 22 milhões de empreendedores brasileiros, ampliando o acesso financeiro em um mercado enorme e carente de soluções.
  • Ownership e construção desde o primeiro dia : como um early team member, você terá papel essencial na criação da área de crescimento de uma startup lucrativa, bem financiada e apoiada pela YCombinator.
  • Aprendizado acelerado com gente boa : aqui você terá a oportunidade de se envolver em projetos estratégicos e enfrentar desafios complexos ao lado de fundadores e operadores de fintechs de ponta. Nossos times são colaborativos, atuam com autonomia e carregam um alto grau de responsabilidade.

O que você pode esperar da gente!

  • Remuneração na faixa alta de mercado;
  • Participação em nosso programa de Stock Options;
  • Learning Budget anual;
  • Plano de Saúde 100% pago pela Zippi para você e para dependentes até 18 anos. Para cônjuges e companheiros (as), cobrimos 50% da mensalidade;
  • Auxílio-creche para crianças até 6 anos;

title: Mobile Engineer (Remote)
description:
The world of digital assets is accelerating in speed, magnitude, and complexity, opening the door to new ways for leveraging the blockchain. Fireblocks’ platform and network provide the simplest and most secure way for companies to work with digital assets and it trusted by some of the largest financial institutions, banks, globally-recognized brands, and Web3 companies in the world, including BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, ANZ Bank, Revolut, and thousands more.

As part of Fireblocks, Dynamic represents the next evolution of non-custodial wallet infrastructure. Dynamic is Fireblocks’ embedded wallet platform, purpose-built for developers who want to bring crypto and stablecoin experiences into modern applications without complexity. Together, Fireblocks and Dynamic are building the most complete, secure, and developer-friendly wallet infrastructure in the industry by combining institutional-grade security with consumer-grade experiences.

About the Team

Dynamic was founded in 2021 with a simple vision: every app and website will have a wallet component. That vision is rapidly becoming reality. Wallets are no longer limited to crypto-native products, they are becoming foundational infrastructure for payroll, remittances, and global payments. Dynamic powers wallet-based experiences for leading crypto and fintech teams including Kraken, zerohash, Magic Eden, and more.

Dynamic builds and maintains developer-first SDKs that enable teams to seamlessly integrate embedded wallet functionality directly into their applications. These embedded wallets allow end users to create, manage, and use wallets without leaving the product experience, making wallets feel like a native part of modern fintech and crypto apps.

As part of Fireblocks, the Dynamic team continues to build and scale the infrastructure and developer tooling that has onboarded 50M+ wallets across crypto and fintech applications. In this context, Dynamic powers the application-layer wallet experience and developer tooling, complementing Fireblocks’ core custody, security, and transaction infrastructure. The team operates with a strong product mindset and deep focus on security, reliability, scalability, and exceptional developer experience. Engineers at Dynamic build secure‑by‑default systems and approach their work with a strong customer focus, balancing technical excellence with real-world user needs. You will be joining a passionate group that moves fast, works with the biggest names in payments and fintech, and is defining how the next generation of financial applications are built.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and implement high-quality native mobile SDKs that enable developers to integrate embedded wallet functionality into their applications, with a strong focus on API ergonomics, performance, and reliability.
  • Own SDK features end-to-end: from API design and architecture, through implementation and testing, to release, versioning, and developer documentation.
  • Build and maintain secure, reliable SDK components for wallet operations, including cryptographic operations, blockchain interactions, and security-sensitive flows.
  • Define and evolve the SDK architecture to support long-term maintainability, backward compatibility, and adoption across diverse customer applications.
  • Build sample applications and demos that showcase SDK capabilities and serve as integration references for customers.
  • Create clear, comprehensive SDK documentation and integration guides.
  • Work with developer relations and support teams to address customer integration challenges.
  • Raise the bar for quality and operational excellence by establishing best practices around testing, observability, releases, and code health.
  • Contribute to a culture of ownership and execution, leading by example through hands‑on work, code reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing.

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with deep focus on mobile development and shipping production‑grade SDKs.
  • Demonstrated track record of building and shipping high‑quality code, with work you can point to and discuss in depth.
  • Strong hands‑on experience with iOS (Swift) and/or Android (Kotlin); experience with React Native or other cross‑platform frameworks, and familiarity with all.
  • Experience building mobile SDKs or shared libraries, including API design, versioning, packaging, and long‑term maintenance across platforms.
  • Experience with blockchain‑enabled mobile systems, including wallet flows, signing, and on‑chain interactions.
  • Experience working on security‑sensitive mobile software, such as key management, secure storage, cryptography, or financial products.
  • Strong grasp of mobile engineering best practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, release management, and observability.
  • A get‑things‑done mindset with the ability to independently own problems and deliver end‑to‑end solutions.
  • Comfortable making long‑term architectural decisions while remaining pragmatic and adaptable.
  • B.Sc. in Computer Science / Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
  • Remote role in a distributed team; preference for candidates in the Americas time zone.

Big Advantages

  • Rust and/or WebAssembly (Wasm) experience, particularly building cross‑platform SDKs consumed by mobile apps.
  • Experience designing shared core logic used across iOS and Android.
  • Experience with advanced mobile security primitives (secure hardware, MPC, low‑level crypto).
  • Prior experience owning or founding a mobile platform or SDK from scratch.

title: Gestor de Incidentes
description:
QUEM SOMOS:

Você é um apaixonado por negócios e Tecnologia e está em busca de novos desafios?Então, a BMP é o seu lugar ! Estamos crescendo cada dia mais e buscando pessoas com espírito de liderança, criativas e atentas à inovação para fazer parte do nosso time. Se você está pronto para fazer parte de um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo e quer transformar o mercado financeiro, confira os requisitos para a vaga de Product Owner.

Sobre a BMP

Somos um Hub de novos modelos de negócios que constrói produtos financeiros e bancários aliados à inovação. Nossas soluções proprietárias e de alta infraestrutura tecnológica atendem a necessidade de cada parceiro de maneira simples, eficiente e segura.

Nossa marca está no centro da revolução financeira, afinal, somos referência em Credit as a Service e o BAAS (Banking As a Service) número 1 do Brasil , com o propósito de transformar o mercado financeiro e construir, junto com os nossos parceiros, o Banco do Futuro.

Principais atividades (Tarefas e atribuições):

Coordenação do Processo de Gestão de Incidentes

  • Assegurar que todos os incidentes sejam identificados, classificados, priorizados e tratados conforme a política
  • Receber notificações, avaliar informações iniciais e direcionar as ações às equipes competentes (TI, NOC, SOC, segurança, negócio).
  • Garantir o cumprimento das etapas formais: notificação, classificação (incluindo NISI), planejamento de ação, execução, registro (RISI) e encerramento.

Comunicação Corporativa de Incidentes

  • Definir e operar um plano de comunicação claro , adequado à severidade:
    • Comunicação simples para incidentes de baixa criticidade;
    • Comunicação estruturada para incidentes médios e altos;
    • Comunicação imediata para Diretoria, Jurídico, áreas de negócio e parceiros críticos nos incidentes graves.
  • Garantir consistência e precisão nas informações compartilhadas.

Integração com Mudanças e Problemas (ITIL/COBIT)

  • Coordenar identificação de mudanças necessárias decorrentes de incidentes críticos ou recorrentes.
  • Apoiar abertura de problemas , especialmente quando houver causa raiz não compreendida ou reincidência.
  • Integrar os três ciclos (Incidentes–Problemas–Mudanças) para:
    • Prevenir reincidências;
    • Garantir implementações em janelas seguras (finais de semana/horários restritos);
    • Incorporar aprendizados no catálogo de mudanças e melhorias.

Governança e Post Mortem

  • Conduzir ou coordenar análises pós-incidente (post mortem) para incidentes de criticidade alta.
  • Elaborar relatórios executivos consolidando causas, impacto, falhas de processo, gaps de controles e recomendações.
  • Propor ações preventivas e corretivas ao Comitê de Segurança e às diretorias.

Atividades‑Chave da Posição

  1. Centralizar a gestão de incidentes em um único ponto de coordenação.
  2. Garantir que incidentes sejam tratados dentro dos SLAs definidos , com escalonamento adequado.
  3. Manter rotinas regulares com NOC/SOC para correlação, investigação e priorização de eventos.
  4. Construir dashboards executivos (status, tendências, tempos de resposta, severidade, reincidência).
  5. Estabelecer critérios claros de severidade , fundamentados em impacto ao negócio, clientes e requisitos regulatórios.
  6. Gerenciar incidentes de segurança , respeitando procedimentos de cadeia de custódia, privacidade e sigilo.
  7. Acionar comitês e lideranças conforme classificação e natureza do incidente .

Do que você precisa (Requisitos e Qualificações):
